plan.title: Remove attachment before publishing single-stage RFQ

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the default event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing can proceed.
Apply the first offered RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER product and quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required by the create flow.
Upload the attachment that should remain.
Upload the second attachment that will be removed.
Confirm the intended remaining attachment is listed before removal.
Confirm the attachment selected for removal is listed.

args.goal: remove the sample.png attachment using its delete control and stop on the single-stage create screen showing sample.pdf listed and sample.png absent

steps.note: Operate the unnamed attachment delete control and finish with evidence of the remaining file.
Assert the remaining attachment is still listed after deletion.
Assert the removed attachment is no longer listed before publishing.
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Add one available QA vendor so the event can be published and viewed by a vendor.
Publish the configured single-stage RFQ.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Check that the remaining attachment is visible on the published project page.
Switch to the invited vendor portal to check vendor visibility.
Open the published event's overview in the vendor portal.
Assert that the remaining attachment is visible to the vendor.
Assert that the removed attachment is not visible to the vendor.
